# ALFA 159 workshop manual (text version)

> Official eLearn workshop manual for the Alfa Romeo 159 (Saloon and Sportwagon, 2005-2008), English, all engines. Each topic is a separate HTML page with its path, applicability, and links to and from related topics.

Start with the guide, then follow links. Use the lookups to jump from a component, fuse or operation code to its pages.

## Start here
- [Guide: how the manual is organised, code systems, wire colours](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/ai/guide.html)
- [Component index: component -> pinouts, replacement procedures, references](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/ai/lookup/components.html)
- [Fuse index: fuse -> every circuit description that names it](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/ai/lookup/fuses.html)
- [Operation index: operation or test code -> topic](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/ai/lookup/operations.html)
- [All sections](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/ai/index.html)

## Sections
- [Technical Data](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/ai/t/939003183.html): technical data / specifications
- [Descriptions](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/ai/t/939003411.html): system description
- [Fault diagnosis](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/ai/t/939003553.html): fault diagnosis table (symptom -> numbered test steps)
- [Test](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/ai/t/939010170.html): test / check procedure
- [Procedures](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/ai/t/939010354.html): repair procedure (removal / refitting; the operation number is the code)
- [Electrical equipment](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/ai/t/939002878.html): 

## Optional
- [Interactive site](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/)
